objective: Implement owner-approved compact executive BUKLOD Home/Cluster/Profile and dark-mode readability on last verified staging-user Android 1.3.2 source, preserving all functioning features; staging only.
productionBaselineEvidence: Last verified published Android staging-user source ab864a2b17e6078252be8ff8c7ce067043c7ce1c, EAS update 01a1ddc3-57fe-7652-abac-3393952aeea1, project 23dad7d0-389a-406e-8dec-08965dab85d8, runtime 1.3.2. Production current runtime and manifest not independently fetched by this DEV change; no production edit permitted.
chosenApproach: Use one source-isolated cumulative DEV branch from immutable current staging source, semantic high-contrast theme tokens, responsive single-row quick actions, and compact UI tokens. Preserve existing data hooks, auth scopes, media/ads handling and analytics.
selectionRationale: Avoid expensive APK/native rebuild or separate services; real compact layout on existing Expo runtime with risk-limited component styling and focused source contracts.
alternativeApproaches: Replace entire Home/Cluster/Profile trees (rejected due risk to data routing and ads)
Draw mockups only (rejected because owner requires implemented staging result)
Remove disclosures or buttons to reduce height (rejected, preserve financial and safety disclosures)
preserveBehaviors: Existing Supabase membership access, Cluster navigation, create/join/manage and offline cache remain authoritative.
Personal posts remain above server-ranked Profile Top 10, no fabricated points or earnings.
Rewarded Ad-Light pass remains an optional earned reward; never change ad unit IDs, impressions, consent or load frequency.
Home existing QMP, Map, Help, PTT, Today, Children Stories, native ad placements and Kingdom route are retained.
Dark theme messaging respects per-user Connect theme overrides, without changing message/RLS/read-sync or calls.
No native plugins, Expo runtime, Android package, Play Store, production, Supabase or Vercel write.
acceptanceChecks: All 12 theme text palettes meet normal-text WCAG contrast on surfaces and bright accent foreground.
16 horizontal px base screen gutter, compact 8–12 px layout rhythm and min 44–48 px interactive controls.
Home announcement, finance, utility, Kingdom and app quick actions render without blank oversized cards.
Cluster tabs are one horizontally scrollable row; cards show title/category/status/Open/Manage without dropped operations.
Profile keeps recent posts, Top 10, overall/monthly positions, rewarded ad and focus panels without copying another user data.
Dark Connect contrast, native and web compile, layout sizing at 360dp and 1.4x font scaling, no media/ads regression.
Staging-specific source/identity/CI/EAS current update readback required before any OTA; production remains unchanged.
